alt: a powder room shown five times from the doorway with identical layouts but five completely different material schemes: oxblood lacquer with marble, forest green zellige tile, limewashed plaster, charcoal micro-cement, and striped wallpaper.
text:
the powder room is where boldness is suddenly affordable.

five versions of one room. same footprint, same light, five different material lives.
oxblood lacquer against marble. forest green zellige. limewashed plaster. micro-cement. stripes.
the third one is the one i keep walking back to.
